objective_statement: Classify the retrospective last-month churn label in the IBM benchmark and discuss the requirements for a prospective platform study.
finding_link: The pipeline compares retrospective classifications using the documented split and train-only preprocessing. Predictor timing and cohort construction are insufficient for a prospective forecast or population survival estimate.

objective_statement: Compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest and XGBoost, plus SVM and MLP extended baselines.
deliverable_statement: Model benchmark with precision, recall, F1, ROC-AUC, plus uncertainty quantification.
evidence_artifacts: model_comparison_metrics (with 95% bootstrap CIs and Brier), model_cv_scores, model_auc_pairwise_tests, model_roc_comparison
finding_link: Five families yield observed AUCs from 0.836 to 0.848 under unequal search budgets. Pairwise tests are exploratory. XGBoost is the fixed illustrative explanation model; the study does not establish operational equivalence or a deployment winner.

objective_statement: Explain the fitted XGBoost model post hoc with SHAP.
deliverable_statement: Explainability bundle: global SHAP, dependence plots, and local case explanations.
finding_link: Global and local SHAP describe the fitted model. Contract, tenure, internet service, security and charges are influential inputs. These attributions do not identify causes or validate latent communication constructs.

objective_statement: Develop communication hypotheses and candidate evaluations from model explanations and contact trade-offs.
deliverable_statement: Authored signal mappings, candidate communication studies and descriptive threshold examples.
finding_link: The mappings separate measured fields, theoretical interpretations, competing explanations and candidate tests. The threshold study reports sample-and-grid trade-offs under assumed classification penalties. User outcomes and unwanted contact would require prospective evaluation.

objective_statement: Deliver an academically coherent final report aligned with CRISP-DM.
deliverable_statement: Technical notebook with reproducibility scaffold + thesis-ready Results, Discussion, Conclusion.
finding_link: The technical report, analytical notebook, short demo and defense deck share exported evidence. Verification checks execution and table agreement; interpretation and presentation are reviewed separately.
